mapper.select: SELECT event.id, event.venue_id, venue.name AS venue_name, venue.timezone AS venue_timezone, event.name, event.description, event.start_time, event.sales_start_time, event.sales_end_time, event.status, CASE WHEN event.status <> 'PUBLISHED' THEN NULL WHEN event.start_time <= #{now} THEN 'ENDED' WHEN event.sales_start_time > #{now} THEN 'UPCOMING' WHEN event.sales_end_time < #{now} THEN 'SALES_CLOSED' WHEN COUNT(event_seat.id) FILTER (WHERE event_seat.permanent_status = 'AVAILABLE') = 0 THEN 'SOLD_OUT' ELSE 'ON_SALE' END AS sales_status FROM events event JOIN venues venue ON venue.id = event.venue_id LEFT JOIN event_seats event_seat ON event_seat.event_id = event.id WHERE event.id = #{eventId} GROUP BY event.id, event.venue_id, venue.name, venue.timezone, event.name, event.description, event.start_time, event.sales_start_time, event.sales_end_time, event.status

SELECT COUNT(event_seat.id) AS seats_total, COUNT(event_seat.id) FILTER (WHERE event_seat.permanent_status = 'AVAILABLE') AS seats_available, COUNT(event_seat.id) FILTER (WHERE event_seat.permanent_status = 'SOLD') AS seats_sold, COUNT(event_seat.id) FILTER (WHERE event_seat.permanent_status = 'BLOCKED') AS seats_blocked, COALESCE(SUM(event_seat.price), 0) AS inventory_value, COALESCE(SUM(event_seat.price) FILTER (WHERE event_seat.permanent_status = 'SOLD'), 0) AS sold_value, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservation_items item JOIN reservations reservation ON reservation.id = item.reservation_id WHERE reservation.event_id = #{eventId} AND reservation.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND reservation.expires_at > #{now} ) AS seats_in_checkout FROM event_seats event_seat WHERE event_seat.event_id = #{eventId}

SELECT purchase_order.currency, COALESCE(SUM(purchase_order.total_amount) FILTER (WHERE purchase_order.status = 'PAID'), 0) AS paid_amount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE purchase_order.status = 'PAID') AS paid_orders, COALESCE(SUM(purchase_order.total_amount) FILTER (WHERE purchase_order.status = 'PENDING'), 0) AS pending_amount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE purchase_order.status = 'PENDING') AS pending_orders FROM orders purchase_order JOIN reservations reservation ON reservation.id = purchase_order.reservation_id WHERE reservation.event_id = #{eventId} GROUP BY purchase_order.currency HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE purchase_order.status IN ('PAID', 'PENDING')) > 0 ORDER BY purchase_order.currency

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE purchase_order.status = 'PAID') AS paid, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE purchase_order.status = 'PENDING') AS pending, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE purchase_order.status = 'FAILED') AS failed, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE purchase_order.status = 'CANCELLED') AS cancelled FROM orders purchase_order JOIN reservations reservation ON reservation.id = purchase_order.reservation_id WHERE reservation.event_id = #{eventId}

SELECT purchase_order.id AS order_id, buyer.email AS buyer_email, purchase_order.status, purchase_order.total_amount, purchase_order.currency, COUNT(item.id) AS seat_count, purchase_order.created_at, purchase_order.updated_at FROM orders purchase_order JOIN reservations reservation ON reservation.id = purchase_order.reservation_id JOIN users buyer ON buyer.id = purchase_order.user_id LEFT JOIN reservation_items item ON item.reservation_id = reservation.id WHERE reservation.event_id = #{eventId} GROUP BY purchase_order.id, buyer.email, purchase_order.status, purchase_order.total_amount, purchase_order.currency, purchase_order.created_at, purchase_order.updated_at ORDER BY purchase_order.created_at DESC, purchase_order.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS issued, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ticket.status = 'ACTIVE') AS active, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ticket.status = 'USED') AS used, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ticket.status = 'CANCELLED') AS cancelled FROM tickets ticket JOIN event_seats event_seat ON event_seat.id = ticket.event_seat_id WHERE event_seat.event_id = #{eventId}

SELECT section.id AS venue_section_id, section.name, event_section.price, event_section.sales_enabled, COUNT(event_seat.id) AS seats_total, COUNT(event_seat.id) FILTER (WHERE event_seat.permanent_status = 'AVAILABLE') AS seats_available, COUNT(event_seat.id) FILTER (WHERE event_seat.permanent_status = 'SOLD') AS seats_sold, COUNT(event_seat.id) FILTER (WHERE event_seat.permanent_status = 'BLOCKED') AS seats_blocked, COALESCE(SUM(event_seat.price) FILTER (WHERE event_seat.permanent_status = 'SOLD'), 0) AS sold_value FROM event_sections event_section JOIN venue_sections section ON section.id = event_section.venue_section_id LEFT JOIN seats seat ON seat.section_id = section.id LEFT JOIN event_seats event_seat ON event_seat.seat_id = seat.id AND event_seat.event_id = event_section.event_id WHERE event_section.event_id = #{eventId} GROUP BY section.id, section.name, section.display_order, event_section.price, event_section.sales_enabled ORDER BY section.display_order ASC, section.name ASC

SELECT DISTINCT ON (item.event_seat_id) item.event_seat_id, purchase_order.id AS order_id, buyer.email AS buyer_email, purchase_order.status AS order_status, purchase_order.created_at AS ordered_at FROM reservation_items item JOIN reservations reservation ON reservation.id = item.reservation_id JOIN orders purchase_order ON purchase_order.reservation_id = reservation.id JOIN users buyer ON buyer.id = purchase_order.user_id WHERE reservation.event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY item.event_seat_id, purchase_order.created_at DESC, purchase_order.id DESC

SELECT (purchase_order.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS sales_date, COUNT(DISTINCT purchase_order.id) AS paid_orders, COUNT(item.id) AS seats_sold FROM orders purchase_order JOIN reservations reservation ON reservation.id = purchase_order.reservation_id LEFT JOIN reservation_items item ON item.reservation_id = reservation.id WHERE reservation.event_id = #{eventId} AND purchase_order.status = 'PAID' AND purchase_order.created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY (purchase_order.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date ORDER BY (purchase_order.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date ASC
